description: How many people are dying of drug overdoses in the US? Returns CDC's provisional 12-month-ending count of drug overdose deaths, reported and predicted (adjusted for delayed reporting), for the US or one state, month by month with the change on a year earlier, from NCHS Vital Statistics Rapid Release. For journalists and policy staff tracking the fentanyl-era trend. Provisional and lagged by several months; no breakdown by drug here. (cost: 1 credit)

months.description: integer, optional, 1-36 most recent months, default 12

state.description: string, optional, US or 2-letter state code (YC or NYC for New York City), default US

name: drug_overdose_deaths_12mo
